Entry Founding of the Night's Watch Entry Founding of the Night's Watch Later people may not agree with the judgment of their ancestors, but they cannot avoid the debt and reputation that have been formed. A past war or a dynastic change will determine today's tax rates, covenants, roads and who has the right to speak first in the hall.

Entry Founding of the Night's Watch Entry Founding of the Night's Watch Later people may not agree with the judgment of their ancestors, but they cannot avoid the debt and reputation that have been formed. They remember which flag fell, which bridge was burned, and who shared the last sip of water in the snow; for them, history is first and foremost the memory left by the body.

Entry Founding of the Night's Watch Entry Founding of the Night's Watch Later people may not agree with the judgment of their ancestors, but they cannot avoid the debt and reputation that have been formed. The winner will write it as a proof of order, the loser will keep it as a warning, and ordinary people will only remember how much the price of food and cemeteries increased that year.

Entry Founding of the Night's Watch Entry Founding of the Night's Watch Later people may not agree with the judgment of their ancestors, but they cannot avoid the debt and reputation that have been formed. They learn about the past through old houses, family trees, tombstones, and taboos spoken by old men; as long as an event affects taxes, conscription, or marriage, it is not truly over.
